steps.title: Observe and decide
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# First, observe the current environment to locate the couch

steps.title: turn
steps.code:

# I can see a room with a table, bench, telescope, and wooden lattice structure
# No couch is visible in this view. I need to turn and explore to find the couch.
# Let me turn left to scan the room.
p.turn(direction="left", degrees=60, visible_state="Room with table, bench, telescope, wooden lattice on right. No couch visible yet. Turning left to search.")
